task: Primary study-interest classification only; not admission prediction or programme eligibility.
test_set: 37 independently generated synthetic held-out cases. GPT-4.1 mini generated and labelled them before Gemini evaluation; one requested 42-case batch returned 37 valid cases and was frozen without supplementation.
limitations: Synthetic labels, small set, and model-generated test authoring are not independent human expert validation. Chinese retrieval remains constrained by English programme metadata.
